{{Top|leg}}
'''Gravitational Rotations''' were a period of time, the length of which varied from [[planet]] to planet. Preparing a [[Smapp]] dish required marinating the creature for a total of two gravitational rotations, then chewing [[Garlic/Legends|garlic]] for between one and three gravitational rotations while waiting for it to detonate.
